newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy, wheat markets quiet.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy, wheat markets quiet.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn, soybean and wheat markets were quiet with corn and soybean values narrowly mixed and wheat values unchanged, grain dealers said.

Owensboro Grain confirmed it bought 150,000 tonnes of optional-origin soybeans Wednesday for May, June, July shipment. There was widespread talk Wednesday and early Thursday the soybeans would be from Brazil, but the Owensboro official said the origin would be the seller's option, which means the soybeans could come from the U.S., Argentina, Brazil or Paraguay.
